newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 1997 inflation seen 15-16 pct - Economy Min.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 1997 inflation seen 15-16 pct - Economy Min.

text.p: Ukraine's annual inflation will be 15-16 percent in 1997, higher than previously estimated but below 1996's 39.7 percent, Economy Minister Yuri Yekhanurov said on Friday.
He had previously predicted annual inflation at about 10 percent this year.
"Since we must raise electricity rates and will do this soon, we suggest this will speed up inflation by 3.5 percent which will bring it to 15-16 percent for the whole year," he told reporters.
Energy Ministry officials said this week they planned to raise power rates by 30 percent for residential consumers and 12 percent for industrial sector users.
